title: GameMaker Library: Overflight added, 87 assets
body:
Overflight is in the GameMaker Library from today, new here first: it has no page of its own yet. That makes 87 assets on this page. If you own the library, download again from your itch.io library at no extra cost: the whole library holds it in the folder for worlds, skies and places, and NEW 2026-11-14: Overflight only holds Overflight alone, so you only download what changed.

What Overflight is

  • A pseudo 3D flight, dive and overworld view for GameMaker in pure GML, with a runnable demo room, THE SKY TRIAL: nine rings down through the clouds to a landing pad.
  • Eight island styles generated from a seed and painted once: coasts with foam, forests, fields with crop rows, rivers, roads, towns as roof clusters, lakes, dunes, sea ice, lava and landing pads. Every seed is a new world.
  • Five times of day, from dawn to a moonlit night where the towns and the lava light up. Eight styles by five times makes 40 presets.
  • Two cloud layers at altitude: fly over them, see their shadows on the ground, and dive through them. Your own sprites are billboarded, sorted against the clouds and cast shadows that shrink with height.
  • A flight rig with fly, dive and kart views that gives the same flight at any frame rate. On the test machine a full 960 by 540 frame with both cloud layers and 12 sprites took about 13 ms in the VM build.

It is the third of three Swing, Smash and Soar systems for action adventure games, after Brandish and Smithereens, so all three are in the library now.

The library now holds 87 assets worth $1,097.13 bought one by one, for $19.99; 10 of them are worlds, skies and places. Every new asset joins on its launch day. The price rises as the library grows: $5 more for new buyers each time three more assets join, $24.99 at 89 assets and $29.99 at 92, never more, and every step will be announced here first with its date. If you own it, you never pay again. Try the free sampler, Drawn in Code, and if the library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made with AI tools: the code and the store images.
